description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of entries in a dataset based on the presence or absence of reference answers and test cases, as part of a 1.4 million open-source distilled reasoning dataset designed to support large language model training. The chart is divided into three segments: the largest, colored pink, represents entries with “Null” values (549,238 items, approximately 39.2%); the second largest, in blue, corresponds to entries that “Have reference answer” (543,935 items, 38.9%); and the smallest, in light green, indicates entries that “Have test case” (306,818 items, 21.9%). A legend in the upper left corner matches each category to its color and count, while percentage labels are placed directly on or near the corresponding slices. The chart’s title, “Distribution of Reference Answer and Test Case,” and the legend’s heading, “w/o Reference Answer and Test Case,” suggest the categories reflect mutually exclusive states — though the near-equal counts for “Null” and “Have reference answer” imply potential overlap or categorization nuance not visually resolved in the chart. The overall visual emphasizes that nearly 40% of the dataset lacks both reference answers and test cases, while roughly 61% includes at least one of these components.
